}(print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgTitle + '" alt="Title">') <h1 class="title">A Trip to Jamaica</h1> <p class="deck">One day. One friend. Every turn is yours.</p> Twenty four hours on an island, then back to class like it never happened. That is the plan, anyway. <h2>Who are you today?</h2> <div class="picker"> <div class="pick"> (print: '<img class="portrait" src="' + $imgBoy + '" alt="Male traveler">') [[Play as a guy->Boy]] </div> <div class="pick"> (print: '<img class="portrait" src="' + $imgGirl + '" alt="Female traveler">') [[Play as a girl->Girl]] </div> </div>(set: $gender to "boy") (set: $friend to "Tia") <h2>Name yourself</h2> You have known Tia since freshman year and never once said the obvious thing out loud. <div class="choices"> (link: "Andre")[(set: $name to "Andre")(go-to: "Conversation with friend")] (link: "Malik")[(set: $name to "Malik")(go-to: "Conversation with friend")] (link: "Type my own")[(set: $name to (prompt: "What is your name?", "Andre"))(go-to: "Conversation with friend")] </div>(set: $gender to "girl") (set: $friend to "Simone") <h2>Name yourself</h2> Simone has been your best friend since the dorm hallway days, and she has never turned down a bad idea. <div class="choices"> (link: "Amara")[(set: $name to "Amara")(go-to: "Conversation with friend")] (link: "Jade")[(set: $name to "Jade")(go-to: "Conversation with friend")] (link: "Type my own")[(set: $name to (prompt: "What is your name?", "Amara"))(go-to: "Conversation with friend")] </div>(if: $gender is "boy")[(print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgDinerBoy + '" alt="Late night talk">')] (else:)[(print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgDinerGirl + '" alt="Late night talk">')] <h2>Thursday, 11:40 pm</h2> The dining hall closed an hour ago and neither of you has moved. (print: $friend) has her feet on the chair across from her, complaining about a group project she will finish at 4 am like she always does. "I need out of here," she says. "Just for a day. Somewhere the air is different." You have had a tab open for three weeks. Round trip, out Saturday morning, back Sunday night. One day on the ground in Jamaica. <div class="choices"> (link: "Turn your phone around and show her")[ (set: $memories to it + (a: "You showed her the tab you had kept open for three weeks.")) (show: ?pitch) ] (link: "Make her guess")[ (set: $memories to it + (a: "You made her guess, and she got it on the second try.")) (show: ?pitch) ] </div> |pitch)[ <h2>"You are serious."</h2> She reads the screen twice. Then she is up and pacing, already listing what she needs to move around. "Okay. Okay, we are doing this." She stops. "Where are we sleeping?" <div class="choices"> (link: "A hotel. Somewhere with a balcony.")[ (set: $stay to "hotel") (set: $memories to it + (a: "You booked a hotel room with a balcony over the water.")) (go-to: "Flight") ] (link: "With the locals. My cousin knows a family in Treasure Beach.")[ (set: $stay to "local") (set: $memories to it + (a: "You took the spare room at Miss Ivy's in Treasure Beach.")) (go-to: "Flight") ] </div> ]<div class="sky"> <svg class="plane" viewBox="0 0 64 32" aria-hidden="true"> <path d="M2 18 L26 16 L38 4 L44 4 L38 16 L58 15 L62 17 L58 19 L38 18 L44 30 L38 30 L26 19 L2 20 Z"/> </svg> <div class="cloud c1"></div> <div class="cloud c2"></div> </div> <p class="cutscene">Three hours over open water.</p> (after: 6s)[ (if: $stay is "hotel")[(go-to: "Hotel")](else:)[(go-to: "Local stay")] ] <div class="choices"> (link: "Skip ahead")[(if: $stay is "hotel")[(go-to: "Hotel")](else:)[(go-to: "Local stay")]] </div>(print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgHotel + '" alt="Hotel room">') <h2>Negril, 6:40 pm</h2> The room is on the fourth floor and the balcony hangs out over the water far enough that the sound of it never stops. (print: $friend) drops her bag, walks straight to the rail, and stands there a full minute without saying anything. "Okay," she says finally. "You did good, (print: $name)." You are both asleep before ten, which is embarrassing and neither of you mentions it. (print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgAckee + '" alt="Ackee and saltfish">') <h2>Morning, terrace level</h2> Ackee and saltfish, fried plantain on the side, hard dough bread, and coffee strong enough to file a complaint about. (print: $friend) takes one bite, closes her eyes, and points at the plate with her fork like it has proven something. "We are getting this again before we leave." She wipes her hands and looks at you across the table. "So. One day. What are we doing with it?" <div class="choices"> [[Decide the day->Hotel Day]] </div>(print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgLocal + '" alt="Miss Ivy&#39;s yard">') <h2>Treasure Beach, 6:40 pm</h2> The taxi turns off the main road onto marl and stops at a blue gate. Miss Ivy is already on the veranda. She hugs (print: $friend) first, then you, then tells you both that dinner was ready an hour ago. Her grandson Kemar takes the bags without being asked. The room has one fan and a window with no glass in it. You fall asleep to dogs, distant bass, and the sea somewhere past the fence. (print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgPatty + '" alt="Patties and sorrel">') <h2>Morning, Miss Ivy's kitchen</h2> Patties still too hot to hold, and cold sorrel in a glass jug with the ice going fast. Miss Ivy watches you take the first bite the way a professor watches an oral exam, then nods once and goes back to the stove. (print: $friend) has red sorrel at the corner of her mouth and no idea. "So. One day. What are we doing with it?" <div class="choices"> [[Decide the day->Local Day]] </div><h2>The day</h2> <div class="choices"> (link: "Live reggae band on the beach")[(set: $activity to "reggae")(set: $activityName to "the reggae set on the beach")(show: ?reggae)] (link: "Raft massage on the river")[(set: $activity to "raft")(set: $activityName to "the raft massage on the river")(show: ?raft)] (link: "Haunted night tour of the great house")[(set: $activity to "haunted")(set: $activityName to "the haunted tour")(show: ?haunted)] </div> |reggae)[ (print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgReggae + '" alt="Reggae band on the beach">') The stage is a plywood platform twenty feet from the water, and by the time the band starts the sun is going down behind them so you cannot look directly at the bass player. The drummer is maybe sixty. The singer is maybe nineteen. They play like they have known each other forever. (print: $friend) kicks her shoes off and leaves them somewhere she will not find them later. Three songs in she stops trying to be cool about it and just dances, badly, with her whole body, and you realise you have never seen her like this on campus. Not once. (set: $memories to it + (a: "She danced barefoot in front of the whole beach and never found her shoes again.")) <div class="choices">[[Later->The Question]]</div> ] |raft)[ (print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgRaft + '" alt="Bamboo raft on the river">') The raft is bamboo, thirty feet of it, poled by a man who has been doing this since before you were born and has opinions about everyone else on the river. You lie flat and the sky moves overhead in pieces between the trees. At the second bend they pull the raft up on a bank of grey mud and a woman works the knots out of your shoulders while the water goes by two feet away. (print: $friend) is on the raft behind yours, absolutely silent for once, one hand trailing in the river. (set: $memories to it + (a: "Bamboo raft, grey mud, and the quietest hour either of you has had in months.")) <div class="choices">[[Later->The Question]]</div> ] |haunted)[ (print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgHaunted + '" alt="Great house tour by lamplight">') The great house is two hundred years old and the guide does not need a microphone or a costume. He walks you through it by lamp, and the story he tells about the woman who ran the place is worse than anything a jump scare could do to you. (print: $friend) grabs your arm on the stairs and does not let go for the rest of the tour. She will claim later that it was the floorboards. It was not the floorboards. (set: $memories to it + (a: "She grabbed your arm on the stairs of the great house and blamed the floorboards.")) <div class="choices">[[Later->The Question]]</div> ]<h2>The day</h2> <div class="choices"> (link: "Yard party down the road")[(set: $activity to "party")(set: $activityName to "the yard party")(show: ?party)] (link: "Raft massage on the river")[(set: $activity to "raft")(set: $activityName to "the raft massage on the river")(show: ?raft)] (link: "Night festival in the square")[(set: $activity to "festival")(set: $activityName to "the night festival")(show: ?festival)] </div> |party)[ (print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgParty + '" alt="Yard party">') Speakers stacked two high against a fence, somebody's uncle on the selector, curry goat under a tarp, children weaving through legs at knee height. Miss Ivy holds the good chair and receives visitors like a head of state. Kemar puts a plate in your hand before you can refuse it. Three aunties adopt (print: $friend) inside of ten minutes and start correcting her footwork, loudly, in front of everybody. She takes the correction. She gets better. They cheer for her like she is family. (set: $memories to it + (a: "Three aunties taught her to move and graded her out loud in front of the whole yard.")) <div class="choices">[[Later->The Question]]</div> ] |raft)[ (print: '<img class="scene" src="' + $imgRaft + '" alt="Bamboo raft on the river">') Kemar knows the man with the rafts and the price drops accordingly. Thirty feet of bamboo, poled by someone who has been doing this since before you were born and has opinions about everyone else on the river. At the second bend they pull up on a bank of grey mud and a woman works the knots out of your shoulders while the water goes by two feet away. (print: $friend) is on the raft behind yours, absolutely silent for once, one hand trailing in the river.
